description: This file defines a PHP trait named ModuleScreenHelperTrait within the OrangeHRM project. The trait provides a protected method getCurrentModuleAndScreen() that returns the current module and screen as a ModuleScreen object by delegating the call to the ModuleScreenHelper class.

methods.name: getCurrentModuleAndScreen
methods.description: Returns the current module and screen as a ModuleScreen object by calling the static method from ModuleScreenHelper.
